activeForm: Fixing the Pod-token find in the sub-hoist pre-pass
description:
FILED s402 (Opus 5), found by the #339 gate-set scan: with the PExpr decline
warn gone, this line became the FIRST stderr line of six companion files and
was noticed.  It is PRE-EXISTING (it is in the s402 before-scan too, one line
lower) and unrelated to the drop work.

    $ printf 'use Unicode::UCD qw(charinfo);\nprint "x\\n";\n' > /tmp/ucd.pl
    $ ./pl2cl --no-cache /tmp/ucd.pl 2>&1 >/dev/null
    Failed to extract prototypes from Unicode::UCD: Can't locate object method
    "find" via package "PPI::Token::Pod" at Pl/Parser.pm line 4891.

So EVERY prototype in Unicode::UCD is silently unavailable to the compiler
(the caller warns and caches undef, Pl/Parser.pm ~8225).  Six companion files
carry it: t/re/anyof.t, t/re/reg_fold.t, t/uni/fold.t, t/uni/lower.t,
t/uni/title.t, t/uni/upper.t.

CAUSE (one line).  Pl/Parser.pm ~4891, inside the let-bound-block sub-hoist
pre-pass (it only runs when `_let_bound_vars` is non-empty, which is why most
files with POD never hit it):

    my $words = $child->find('PPI::Token::Word') || [];

`$child` is a top-level document child, and a `PPI::Token::Pod` is a TOKEN, not
a `PPI::Node` — `find` is a Node method.  The loop above it skips Whitespace
and Comment by class name and nothing else.

FIX: ask the class, not the name —

    my $words = $child->isa('PPI::Node')       ? ($child->find('PPI::Token::Word') || [])
              : $child->isa('PPI::Token::Word') ? [$child] : [];

(`__END__`/`__DATA__` separators and Pod are the other top-level tokens.)

BAR: corpus-diff (the fix restores prototypes, so emission CAN move for any
file that uses a module with top-level POD in a let-bound block), the gate, and
the sweep if corpus-diff shows diffs.  Not folded into s402 because a sweep was
already in flight for the #339/#343 batch — piling a second compiler change on
a measurement in flight is how a verdict stops meaning anything.


DONE s404 (commit a82acbc), exactly as diagnosed: ask isa('PPI::Node'), the
guard shape Parser2::_collect_named_subs already uses.  Unicode::UCD declares
13 prototypes and all 13 were being thrown away.  MEASURED: corpus-diff
identical (111 files), emission-ab over BOTH populations 657/657 SAME — so no
file in either population was mis-compiled by it; the fix removes a latent
silent-wrong and the stderr noise.  Inverse-checked at HEAD (worktree):
prototype MISSING -> FOUND.  Guard: 3 rows in Pl/t/prototype-01.t over a
minimised fixture (POD inside a block that binds a lexical and calls a sub
before defining it).
subject: Prototype extraction dies on any module with top-level POD in a let-bound block (Unicode::UCD, 6 companion files) — ->find called on a PPI::Token::Pod
